items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: And we were on the band bus and Connie Hayes was standing next to me and we were on the Fiftieth Anniversary.

ctx.x: Not like a “You’re fired, get off my bandstand.” He’d say, “Go home.” And we were on the band bus and Connie Hayes was standing next to me and we were on the Fiftieth Anniversary. And I don’t know, somebody said something. I said, “Why don’t you go home?” And she says, “I haven’t heard that phrase since I was with Harry James in 1939.” I said, “What? Go home?” She says, “Oh yeah, that’s how he used to fire guys.” He’d say, “Go home.” Very low key to get the point across.
Sometimes I’ve felt like I was born too late.
